text: Astrogenes are special genetic mutations that only become active in orbit. They don't count towards complexity and metabolism of the gene carrier, but they have no effect on the surface of a planet.
This ability can only be used while in orbit
By default, Starjacks will spawn with 2 Astrogenes. With this you can make the spawn with anything from 0 to 5 Astrogenes. This will obviously not affect already existing Starjacks!
Propel yourself to a very distant location in the vacuum of space.

Carriers of this gene possess a specialized muscular tail that functions as a propulsion organ, allowing them to launch themselves across vast distances in the vacuum of space. This ability cannot be used in atmospheres.
Carriers of this gene have hardier circulatory and respiratory systems, reducing the rate at which hypoxia builds up in the vacuum of space.
Carriers of this gene do not suffer fatal hypothermia. Instead, their bodies gradually slow down and enter a dormant state when exposed to extreme cold, and they can awaken safely once warmed.

Carriers of this gene are slightly averse to oxygen-rich environments. In breathable atmosphere, they experience minor respiratory and neurological strain, accompanied by a subtle discomfort with each breath.

Carriers of this gene suffer severe discomfort and reduced bodily function in oxygenated environments. Exposure to breathable air causes pain, weakness, and labored breathing, making planetary survival difficult.

Carriers of this gene cannot survive in oxygen-rich environments. Exposure to breathable atmospheres causes rapid lung failure and eventual death. Only the vacuum of space or low-oxygen gravship environments can sustain them.

Carriers of this gene thrive in space. Their bodies are highly adapted to zero-atmosphere conditions, allowing for faster and more efficient work outside planetary environments. However, they function poorly on terrestrial surfaces.

Carriers of this gene are naturally suited for life aboard gravships. Their genetic makeup enhances their coordination, perception, and technical aptitude in zero-gravity environments, making them exceptional pilots and crew.
